matching_contract.mathml_storage: Exact source substrings with inherited m namespace; parse inside a namespace-bearing wrapper. Math ordinals are one-based within their top-level source anchor.
matching_contract.dispatch: Require module, top-level anchor, math ordinal, and exact namespace-aware element tree including attributes and tokens. Whitespace-only formatting may differ; no token, element, attribute, or operand normalization is authorized.
matching_contract.preserve_source_punctuation: Commas separate alternatives; final MathML periods end sentences. Spoken punctuation is a pause, not a decimal or multiplication operator.
matching_contract.register_note: Fixed mathematical readings intentionally overlap across the two Javanese registers. Surrounding prose remains separately labeled.
matching_contract.provider_behavior: No voice/provider selected. A later synthesizer must support the requested locale explicitly or return unsupported_voice_locale, never substitute Indonesian for Javanese silently.
